verdict.rationale: Relay offers built-in high-yield savings accounts (up to 3.00% APY) that automatically pull idle operating cash into yield-bearing accounts within the same platform, and community evidence corroborates that tax/reserve balances earn extra interest without moving funds elsewhere. missing for 10: independent verification of actual APY competitiveness/consistency over time, and clearer detail on withdrawal friction or limits on savings-account access for operating cash.
